# BarcodeContentException

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Raised when a value cannot be encoded in the requested [`BarcodeSymbology`](barcode-symbology.md) (wrong length, invalid characters, etc.).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `BonniePdfError`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new BarcodeContentException(symbology: BarcodeSymbology, message: string)
```

## Properties

- [`symbology`](#symbology): The symbology that rejected the value.

```typescript
readonly symbology: BarcodeSymbology
```

The symbology that rejected the value.
